table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date =	CASE lower(:as_datetype)
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'date' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
		End,
	patientcode = Max(dbo.saleledger.patientcode),
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.customer.cp, 
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city,
	netamount = 
		Round(
			SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
				saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		Round(
			SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
			  (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
			  (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
				saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
	patientname = Patient.name,
	Rank = (Select dbo.rank.name From dbo.Rank Where dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode),
	Relation = (Select dbo.relation.name From dbo.Relation Where dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode),
	OrderDate        = dbo.saleledger.billingdate,
	CustRefNo        = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	CustRefNo2        = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo2,
	CustRefNo3        = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo3,
	CustRefNo4        = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo4,
	NationalIDCard 	= dbo.patient.NationalIDCard
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,   
	dbo.accounts, 
	dbo.customer,
	dbo.Patient	

WHERE 
	CASE 
	WHEN lower(:as_datetype)  = 'originaldate' THEN dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
	WHEN lower(:as_datetype)  = 'lastsavingdate' THEN dbo.saleledger.date 
	WHEN lower(:as_datetype)  = 'billingdate' THEN dbo.saleledger.billingdate 
	ELSE dbo.saleledger.date 
	End Between :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  = :al_CustCode and 
	ISNULL(dbo.saleledger.custrefno, '')  = ISNULL(CASE WHEN lower(:as_datetype)  = 'date' THEN :as_ref ELSE dbo.saleledger.custrefno END, '') AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode and
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode

GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.originaldate,
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	dbo.Patient.RegNo,
	dbo.Patient.Name,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	 
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.patient.rankcode,
	dbo.saleledger.relationcode,
	dbo.accounts.name,	
	dbo.customer.cp,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city,
	dbo.saleledger.billingdate,
	dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo2,
	dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo3,
	dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo4,
	dbo.patient.NationalIDCard
UNION ALL
